data.one_liner: FFI bindings to the GNU C Library on Linux and the BSD C Library on macOS
data.what_it_does: Provides Foreign Function Interface (FFI) bindings for standard C library functions on Linux and macOS. It allows developers to call system calls and standard C functions directly from Dart.
use_when: You need to access low-level operating system functions via C standard library bindings on Linux or macOS.
You are building system-level command line tools or utilities in Dart for Unix-like environments.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Linux or macOS.
You prefer pure Dart abstractions over direct C function bindings.
strengths: Provides direct access to low-level C library functions.
Supports common system operations like process management, file operations, and system information.
weaknesses: Limited platform support (only Linux and macOS).
Requires dealing with low-level FFI and C paradigms.

alternatives.name: posix
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides alternative POSIX bindings for Dart.
